'''Pearl''' was the name of [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mantellian flutterplume/Legends|Mantellian flutterplume]] owned by the [[Ravagers]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] during the [[Coratanni]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3637 BBY]] a group of individuals hired by Coratanni's predecessor [[Ruugar]] stormed the ship ''[[Pearl's Girl]]'', named after the flutterplume, and killed both Coratanni and her pet after a prolonged fight.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pearl appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
